risk: Interest is computed at a rate other than the contracted rate (benchmark + spread + risk premium, or fixed rate), misstating interest income and overcharging/undercharging customers.
control_description: The core banking system (CBS) derives the loan rate automatically from the product master and the sanctioned risk premium at account set-up.
test_procedure: Full-population recalculation of interest for every loan-period from contract terms; exceptions re-performed under a solved 'implied spread' hypothesis.
recommendation: Reconcile CBS account-level rates to sanction letters for the population flagged; add a system validation that the account rate equals the product-derived rate at set-up and on every rate change.

risk: Floating-rate loans are repriced late, so benchmark changes (e.g. RBI repo moves) reach borrowers after the contracted reset date - a regulatory issue under the EBLR framework and an income misstatement.
control_description: CBS resets floating rates automatically on each loan's reset date using the benchmark in force on that date.
test_procedure: Recalculated reset dates from disbursal anniversaries and reset frequency; benchmark looked up on the reset date from the RBI repo history; exceptions re-performed under a 'one cycle late' hypothesis.
population_description: Rate reset events on floating loans
recommendation: Review the CBS batch job that applies resets (run date vs value date); re-price affected accounts and refund/recover differences; add a reset-exception report reviewed monthly.

risk: The wrong day-count basis (e.g. 30/360 instead of Actual/365) misstates daily accrual.
control_description: CBS applies the day-count convention defined per product in the product master.
test_procedure: Recalculated accrual under each product's documented convention; exceptions re-performed under 30E/360.
recommendation: Correct the day-count parameter for the affected account group (appears to be a legacy migration batch); test the parameter for all products.

risk: Interest during a moratorium is capitalised monthly (interest on interest), contrary to the product terms.
control_description: CBS accrues moratorium interest as simple interest to a separate non-interest-bearing bucket.
test_procedure: Recalculated moratorium accrual as simple interest; exceptions re-performed with monthly capitalisation.
recommendation: Fix the moratorium accrual routine; quantify and refund compounded interest to affected borrowers.

risk: Penal charges are levied as penal interest (added to the rate) or capitalised, contrary to RBI's Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges circular (18-Aug-2023; effective 01-Apr-2024, existing loans by 30-Jun-2024).
control_description: CBS books a fixed penal charge per bounced instalment to a separate receivable, with no interest on it.
test_procedure: Recalculated penal charges for every bounced instalment from the transaction file; exceptions re-performed as capitalisation or as penal interest at 1-3% p.a.
population_description: Bounced instalments (5,517 under the 2024 penal-charge regime)
recommendation: Complete the penal-charge regime migration for residual accounts; report the breach to Compliance; refund excess charges.

risk: Interest is rounded daily instead of once per billing period, creating systematic small differences.
control_description: CBS rounds interest half-up to 2 decimals once per billing period.
test_procedure: Recalculated with period-level rounding; exceptions re-performed with daily rounding at 0, 1 and 2 decimals.
recommendation: Align the rounding parameter for the affected accounts; low monetary impact but indicates inconsistent configuration.

risk: A product master change (spread cut on HL-FLT from 01-Oct-2023) is not propagated to existing accounts - an ITGC change-management failure flowing into an application control.
control_description: Approved product master changes are applied to all accounts at their next reset (ITAC relies on ITGC change management).
test_procedure: Recalculated rates using the product master spread history; exceptions re-performed with the pre-change spread retained.
population_description: HL-FLT resets on/after the 01-Oct-2023 spread change (pre-change loans)
recommendation: Inspect the change ticket and post-implementation review for the 01-Oct-2023 change; extend ITGC testing to other parameter changes in the period; re-price affected accounts.

risk: Interest continues to accrue after a loan is fully prepaid or closed.
control_description: CBS stops accrual on the value date of closure.
test_procedure: Recalculated accrual up to the closure value date; exceptions re-performed with accrual to period end.
population_description: Loan closures in window (prepayment or maturity)
recommendation: Fix value-dating of full prepayments; reverse post-closure interest and refund borrowers.

risk: ACT/ACT products use a 365-day year in leap years, overstating interest in 2024.
control_description: CBS uses the actual number of days in the year (366 in leap years) for ACT/ACT products.
test_procedure: Recalculated 2024 accruals on a 366-day basis; exceptions re-performed with a 365-day basis.
recommendation: Correct the year-basis parameter; reverse 2024 over-accrual for affected MSME accounts.
